description: This file defines the RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse class, which represents the response to a RetrieveFeatureProperties command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing feature properties, and serializing the object. The class is immutable and leverages JSON serialization/deserialization mechanisms.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a feature properties retrieval command, capable of JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing access to feature and thing identifiers as well as feature properties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse from ThingId, featureId, FeatureProperties, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object to create an instance of RetrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureProperties
methods.description: Returns the FeatureProperties contained in the response.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity JSON value, returning a new instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
